reason: Freeze lifted by owner order 2026-08-28 (Gonzalo). New indexable URLs are allowed when demand-backed: each new URL must cite a GSC query/impression signal or an intent gap named in the wave evidence, ship with title/meta/schema/internal links, and register a GSC follow-up date. Blind volume expansion remains prohibited.

consolidationExecuted.decisionSource: cohort-decisions-esteban-2026-08-12 (vault), re-validated against the 2026-08-19 Search Console run
consolidationExecuted.enforcedBy: config/cohort-consolidation.json via lib/consolidation.ts, applied in app/sitemap.ts and lib/site-metadata.ts
consolidationExecuted.note: The 2026-08-12 decisions had been documented and never shipped; all 21 MERGE URLs were still live and sitemapped on 2026-08-19. Requirement 1 of unfreezeRequires is therefore met, and the drift in the Search Console watch set is explained by this entry, satisfying requirement 2. Requirement 3 is per-URL and still outstanding.
consolidationExecuted.exemptionNote: 31 URLs were pulled out of execution: 4 AI/web-theme pages seeding the 2026-08-19 positioning; 15 whose coverageState is 'URL is unknown to Google' (never fetched, so no rejection to act on); and 12 whose language counterpart survives, since NOINDEX is applied symmetrically across a bilingual pair or not at all.
consolidationExecuted.deferralNote: All 19 MERGE decisions were deferred; see deferralReason in config/cohort-consolidation.json.
consolidationExecuted.scope: Service and niche pages only; all /guides/ and /es/guias/ URLs are deferred to the merge track.

exceptions: A redirect or canonical consolidation that does not increase the sitemap URL count
A replacement URL approved in the same change as removal of an existing indexable URL
Up to allowedNewIndexableUrls new demand-backed URLs per demand-wave run, each with cited evidence and a follow-up date
unfreezeRequires: Every current sitemap URL classified as keep, improve, merge, redirect, or remove
No unexplained sitemap drift in the fixed Search Console watch set
A written demand-and-conversion hypothesis plus owner for each proposed URL

ownerOrderedAdditions.demandEvidence: NONE. This is an owner-ordered affiliate/monetization page, not a demand-backed SEO page. It consumes one of the two allowed new indexable URLs WITHOUT the GSC query/impression signal the freeze reason requires. Recorded here so the exception is visible rather than silent.
ownerOrderedAdditions.followUp: Check GSC for impressions on /desk-recommendations. If still zero at 30 days, this URL is dead weight and should be noindexed or merged.
